name: 100 Super Skills (owner repository) vendored into KOSIF Superpowers
upstream_license: MIT (c) 2026 Kosif; each skill's references/sources.md names the permissive sources it was composed from
integration_mode: whole skill folders copied (text, plus small OFL fonts, sound effects and images); large media and bundles stay upstream and are listed per skill under left_upstream
policy: text <= 1000000 bytes, binary <= 512000 bytes, no video, no caches; files are not executable; KOSIF runs nothing here except each skill's own tests in a temporary copy (selftest)

kosif_patches.why: find sibling super skills next to this folder (vendor/100-superskills/skills or ~/.claude/skills) instead of only the owner's Windows Desktop path
a skill that is not installed in ~/.claude/skills but sits beside kosif-one still resolves (with its path)
installed-skill check accepts the sibling folder; skills from other packages (ultra-motion-montage, motion-os) are skipped when absent instead of failing
the Motion test class needs a scripts/motion/ folder that the upstream package never shipped (KOSIF Motion lives in hyperframes-animation-studio); skip it with that reason instead of 5 errors
ffmpeg 6+ prints no frame= line for a stream-copy pass, so nb_frames was missing; fall back to a decode pass
